import sys
from solution import merge_intervals

# Test 1: Empty input
assert merge_intervals([]) == []

# Test 2: Single interval
assert merge_intervals([(1, 5)]) == [(1, 5)]

# Test 3: Overlapping intervals
assert merge_intervals([(1, 3), (2, 4), (5, 7)]) == [(1, 4), (5, 7)]

# Test 4: Touching intervals
assert merge_intervals([(1, 3), (3, 5)]) == [(1, 5)]

# Test 5: Isolated zero-length interval
assert merge_intervals([(2, 2)]) == [(2, 2)]

# Test 6: Invalid interval
try:
    merge_intervals([(3, 1)])
    assert False, "Expected ValueError"
except ValueError:
    pass

print("All tests passed.")
